tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i yab chos yang phur rnam gnyis kyi srung mar mchod gtor 'bul tshul ma mo rab dga' bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka shrī badzra ku mā ra ya/ kun khyab bde stong zung 'jug las/ /rnam 'phrul 'jigs rung khro bo'i sku/ /bla ma yang phur rjer btud de/ /gang de'i bka' srung gtor chog 'dri/ /'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi yab chos rnying ma dpal chen yang dag dang / rdo rje phur pa'i bka' srung dam can nag mo sde gsum mched bcu gnyis su grags pa 'di rnams la sa skya lo tsā ba sogs gdung brgyud rnams kyi thugs dam gtor bsngo rgyun pa'i gras la bskyed chog mi mdzad par spyan 'dren gtor 'bul bstod pa mdzad khun dang / rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil chog skabs ni/ dkyil 'khor phyi rim 'khor yug na/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis sogs/ /dam tshig la dgongs 'khod par gyur/ /zhes brjod pa dang bstun phyogs bzhir za 'og gi 'bol la dbang phyug ma bdun re dang / mtshams bzhir khrag mtsho la byang shar du bdag nyid ma re ma ti shwa na ma khyi gdong ma sa bdag ma spyi byin/ shar lhor re ma ṭa 'phar gdong ya byin/ lho nub tu re ma dza wa gdong bse byin/ nub byang du re ma dzu spyang gdong phag byin rnams bsgoms nas phyi nang gsang mchod sogs gtso 'khor thams cad la lhan cig tu 'bul zhing / srung mar gtor bsngo sogs sger du mdzad pa'ang yod/ yang rgyun par yang 'di rnams la bskyed chog dang 'brel ba'i gtor bsngo'ang rung bas/ de'i tshul ni rang gi rgyun gtor 'bul ba'i gtor gras la 'di rnams gcig 'thus kyi gtor ma gru gsum gcig yang na gru gsum bzhi tshan gsum bcos pa sha mar gyi brgyan cing mdzes/ so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i mda' dar can nam ci 'byor gyi bsham byas la nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs spos kyis bdug

bdag mdun yi dam chos srung la gtor ma 'bul gras sa lo'i phyag len la bdag bskyed bde kyai phur sogs gang rung byas nas/ kyai rdor/ bde mchog gur zhal/ dur khrod bdag po/ las mkhan lnga/ dkar bdud rnams la phul rjes/ phur srung gtor bsngo mdzad pas gong du bshad pa'i gtor ma rgyas bsdus bshams gang byas de dag la byin rlabs rgyas pa ni yi dam gtor bsngo'i sngon du/ kyai rdo rje lta bus gtor ma byin rlabs mdzad pa des 'thus par mdzad nas/ de man phal cher la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes sam/ yang na oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho zhes sogs sna tshogs mdzad srol las/ phur srung gtor ma la ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥgasungs pas sngags de brjod pa bstun lag g.yon g.yas gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bcas pa lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi gzhir/ /bhyoḥyig bcu gnyis yongs gyur las/ /nam gru nag mo re ma ti/ /me long sbrul zhags phur bu 'dzin/ /gos nag rus rgyan ral pa 'phyang / /drel rta rkang gsum chibs su chibs/ /bstan srung ser nag re ma ṭa/ /g.yu zor gser gyi par bu 'dzin/ /sgro thul rus rgyan ral pa 'phyang / /shwa ba yu mo chibs su chibs/ /khrag 'thung dmar nag re ma dzaḥ bandha khrag bkang lcags kyu 'dzin/ /re lde rus rgyan ral pa 'phyang / /chu glang nag po chibs su chibs/ /dam can ljang nag re ma dzu/ /khrag baṃ mtshon gyi gru gu 'dzin/ /dar chun rus rgyan ral pa 'phyang / /rnga mo gwa pa chibs su chibs/ /zangs kyi mi mo wa gdong dmar/ /gcer mo rdo rje phur bu 'dzin/ /ral gcig cod paṇa rus pa'i brgyan/ /wa mo rkang gsum chibs su chibs/ /gser gyi mi mo 'phar gdong ser/ /gcer mo lcags kyu phur pa 'dzin/ /ral gcig cod paṇa rus pa'i brgyan/ /gser 'phar lce brgyad chibs su chibs/ /lcags kyi mi mo spyang gdong sngo/ /gcer mo thod dbyug phur pa 'dzin/

/ral gcig cod paṇa rus pa'i brgyan/ /lcags spyang mgo dgu chibs su chibs/ /g.yu yi mi mo khyi gdong mthing / /gcer mo zhing chung phur bu 'dzin/ /ral gcig cod paṇa rus pa'i brgyan/ g.yu khyi ral can chibs su chibs/ /bdud lcam spyi byin gcer mo nag /lcags kyu phur 'dzin g.yu 'brug zhon/ /mthing nag skra grol phur phreng ldan/ /bse mo ku landha ri ma/ /gza' lcam ya byin gcer mo ser/ /zhags pa phur 'dzin chu srin zhon/ /ser nag skra grol phur phreng ldan/ /bse mo shu landha ri ma/ /btsan lcam bse byin gcer mo dmar/ /lcags sgrog phur 'dzin glog dmar zhon/ /dmar nag skra grol phur phreng ldan/ /bse mo tsa mundha ri ma/ /klu lcam phag byin gcer mo ljang / /dril bu phur 'dzin klu ra zhon/ /ljang nag skra grol phur phreng ldan/ /bse mo kaṃ ka dha ri ma/ /de kun rang rang 'khor gyis bskor/ /kun gyi dpral mgrin snying ka ru/ /rdo rje gsum dngos oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rang nyid yi dam thugs ka nas/ /'od 'phros phur srung bcu gnyis po/ /skad cig nyid la sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol rdo rje g.yab dril bu gsil la/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dha ti ma ma shrī grāṃ karma ka ra ma ra se na pra ma dha ni sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing / dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sngon po phyed pa res dbu brgyan/ badzra sa mā ya satwaṃ/ badzra sa mā ya hoḥ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang /

rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar gcod pa dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ gong gi sngags kyi sa pā ri wā ra yan gyi rjes su i daṃ bha liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs lan gsum mam lnga yis gtor ma phul la/ nang mchod gtor zhing / ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor gzhi bdag gtor ma rnams mdzad nas/ 'khon gcugs sbyang ba'i yig brgya/ yi dam sngags kyi mgo gnon gong gi chos srung gral rim gyi bzlas pa/ phur srung la sngags bzla ba 'dod na/ pra mardha ni bar gong bzhin la hūm̐ phaṭa ces sbyar/ de nas phyi mchod nang mchod 'dod gsol chos srung spyi bshags mdzad nas bskang gso mi mdzad na gur lcam dral zhal gyi sngags thung rnams dril gsil bcad stabs/ bstod pa shlau ka re mdzad pas dkar bdud bstod pa'i rjes su phur srung bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs bdag nyid ma/ /shwa na mu kha bse mo bzhi/ /phur srung rnams la bstod par bgyi/

/rgyas par na gong gi bskyed chog de la bdag nyid ma bzhi'i tshig rkang rjes mar chibs la bstod ces bsgyur ba dang bzhi ka rdzogs nas/ bdag nyid mched bzhi bstod pa'i mthus/ /sa bstan gdung brgyud lha mi'i sde/ /srid mthar 'phel zhing bdag cag gi /ci bsam don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces dang / shwa na ma bzhi'i tshig rkang rjes mar yang chibs la bstod/ ces bsgyur/ bzhi ka rdzogs nas/ shwa na mched bzhi bstod pa'i mthus zhes sogs gong bzhin/ bse mo bzhi'i tshig rkang rjes mar/ ku landha re khyed la bstod/ /shu landha ri khyed la bstod/ /tsa mundha ri khyed la bstod/ /kam ka dha ri khyed la bstod/ /ces dang / bzhi ka rdzogs nas bse mo mched bzhi bstod pa'i mthus/ sogs gong bzhin/ de nas rdor glu bkra shis smon lam spyi bstabs mjug chog rnams yin kyang / rang rang gi phyag len ltar babs sgril ma 'chol bar bya/ yang dkar bdud phur srung kho na ma gtogs gtor bsngo gzhan mi byed na/ 'das gtor phur pa'i dpal bshos gcig dkar mo'i zlum gtor/ bdud rgyal gyi gru gsum phur srung la rgyas bsdus gong bzhin chu gnyis nyer mchod bcas bshams la/ sbyangs bdug byas/ rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa yang snying lhan skyes som de'i dgongs pa sa lo'i gsungs la sngags 'chang rjes mchan mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od can lta bu bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ dkar bdud phur srung gtor ma/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas bstim pa zhes pa'i bar phur pa'i sman byin rlabs bzhin la 'og gi gtor ma dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur zhes dang / gzhong pa 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dzwa ba liṃ ta sogs lan gsum brjod pa'am/ yang na oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes sam/ yang na oṃ.āḥhūm̐ zhes gang byas kyang mi 'gal te dang po ni gzhung gi dngos bstan yin zhing /

gnyis pa ni dkar bdud gtor bsngo las 'byung / gsum pa ni rdo rje phur pa'i gser skyems byin rlabs skabs sngags 'chang chen pos gsungs pas so/ /bskyed chog ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du bhyoḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba can/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i ri rab sgong rdor 'phen zhing / g.yon pas gling bzhi byo bzlog tu mdzad pa/ nyi zla brgya yis dbu la brgyan pa/ nyi zla dgu brgyas do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dkar po'i na bza' can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yon du rta nag po'i steng du hūm̐ las bdud kyi rgyal po thod pa'i phreng ba can sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas ba dan nag po nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas rus phreng 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' can mi mgo'i phreng ba dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor 'chi bdag nag po rang dang 'dra ba brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyis gnas nas dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ bhyoḥ che ba'i che mchog gsang ba'i gzugs/ /thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ /srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po yang / /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma la satwaṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing / dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/

rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badzra sa mā ya satwaṃ/ badzra sa ma ya hoḥ dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar gcod pa dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ badzra shīntaṃ padma kurtiṃ bhyoḥ oṃ sarba ma ra kṛṣṇa kā pā la mā la dha ra sa pa ri wā rā i daṃ bha liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha truṃ bighnan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam lngas gtor ma phul/ oṃ arghaṃ nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ shīntaṃ ku ru/ puṣṭiṃ wa shaṃ ku ru/ dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang / mdzad phrin gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ de nas phur srung dam can bcu gnyis kyi gtor ma la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas nas gong bzhin phur srung la gtor bsngo bya/ bstod pa'i skabs su/ dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla ni/ /dar dkar 'jol ber sku la gsol/

/ri rab gling bzhi phyag na bsnams/ /skye 'gro gso mdzad khyed la bstod/ /dpal chen bka' yi pho nya ni/ /rlung gi shugs can bdud rta'i steng / /mdog nag ru mtshon thod phreng can/ /bdud rgyal mgon po khyed la bstod/ /'phrin bcol byed na/ dkar mo bdud rgyal bstod pa'i mthus sogs rigs 'gre sbyar/ yang na dkar bdud phur srung la/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan dkar mo chen mo ni/ /sngon tshe che mchog he ru ka'i/ /spyan sngar khas blangs de bzhin du/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba dang / /dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba dang / /sgrub po 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang / /bsam pa'i don rnams sgrub pa dang / /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /hūm̐/ sngon tshe bdud kun gyi ni bdag po che/ /shin tu mi bzad rdo rje khrag 'thung gi /spyan sngar dam bcas bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung nag po che la bstod/ /hūm̐/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam can ma mo sde gsum mched bcu gnyis/ /rnam lnga rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ma sring mdza' mo'i tshul gyis grogs mdzod cig /thugs dam rjes dgongs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /zhes pa'i bar ram/ yang na kho bos byas pa'i dpal 'bar lha'i rnga sgra ltar byas la ye shes ldan sogs mjug chog bya zhing / brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol skabs su gang babs bya'o/ /gal te bskang ba bya bar 'dod na/ dkar bdud kyi bskang ba rgyas bsdus ni gzhan nas 'byung / phur srung bskang ba gtor ma mchod pa ni de kas 'thus/ spyan gzigs chang phud sogs ci 'byor bshams la/ spyan 'dren ni gu gul sha chen sogs kyi dud pa sbyar/ rnga rol rkang gling gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ bskal bzang rgyal ba bzhi pa shāka thub kyi/

/bstan pa 'di la rdo rje theg pa byon/ /nye lam smin grol zab mo'i yang snying mchog /rdo rje phur pa'i bka' srung bdag nyid bzhi/ /shwa na mched bzhi bse mo mched bzhi rnams/ /so so'i bka' 'khor sprul pa yang sprul tshogs/ /sngon dus gdug can ru tra bsgral dus dang / /padma'i spyan sngar dam bcas rjes dran gshegs/ /bdag cag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dpa' gdeng bskyed nas su/ /thub bstan spel zhing gdul bya rjes 'dzin sogs/ /yang dag lam zhugs bar chad bsrung phyir gshegs/ /sngon tshe dpal chen bka' bsgos dam tshig dang / /srog snying phul nas ji ltar zhal bzhes ltar/ /da lta rig 'dzin sgrub mchog bdag bskul na/ /ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhes dang rol mo'i bar la gtor bsngor bshad pa'i spyan 'dren sngags brjod/ rang bzhin dag pa 'bar ba'i pho brang du/ /rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i drung / /so so'i gdan bzhugs sman raka gtor tshogs rnams/ /bzhes nas ji ltar bsgo ba'i las mdzod cig /zhes dang / gtor bsngo ltar 'bul sngags sman raka phul la 'dod gsol bya/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma dag snod bcud rnam rol ji snyed pa/ /dag pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dam can rgya mtsho dges pa'i rang bzhin te/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul 'bul gyis dgyes skong mdzod/ /gtsang zhim mchod yon rnam bkra'i me tog 'khrigs/ /spos dang yid tshim snang gsal mun pa'i sgra/ /sim ster dri dang bcud ldan bza' bca' btung / /snyan 'jebs nga ro la sogs phyi mchod kyis/ /dam can bdag nyid mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /rno myur shwa na mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /kun khyab bse mo mched bzhi'i༞ /'khor bcas thugs dam skong la phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ rab dkar dpa' bo dpa' mo'i ka pā la/ /tshad ldan snod mchog thabs shes mtshon pa'i nang /

/sman phud dza gad btung ba rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /rakta rba klong 'khrugs sogs nang mchod kyis/ /dam can bdag nyid༞ /rno myur shwa na༞ /kun khyab bse mo༞ /'khor bcas thugs dam༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ dgra bgegs thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar/ /lcags kyu sgron me ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /sha khrag rus pa'i gtor ma rgyan ldan 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas spel sogs gsang mchod kyis/ /dam can bdag nyid༞ /rno myur shwa na༞ /kun khyab bse mo༞ /'khor bcas thugs dam༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ phyag rgya lnga dang bse byang phur ral brgyan/ /dar nag sgro thul re lde za 'og ber/ /zhing glang stag sham rgyan gos sna tshogs pa/ /rang rang rus pa'i rgyan gos mchod sprin gyis/ /dam can bdag nyid༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ me long gser par bandha khram baṃ dang / /zhing chung lcags kyu rdo rje dbyug to 'bar/ /lcags kyu zhags sgrog dril bu phur bu sogs/ /phrin las nyer sgrub phyag mtshan du ma yis/ /dam can༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ bha ga'i klong dang thod mkhar dur khrod yul/ /mar khu zhag khrag 'o ma'i mtsho chen sogs/ /thugs dam dbang gis bzhugs gnas sna tshogs par/ /mkho dgu'i spyad ldan dam can pho brang gis/ /dam can༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ drel rta sha yu chu glang rnga mo che/ /khyi 'phar wa spyang gcan gzan gdug pa can/ /g.yu 'brug chu srin glog dmar klu ra sngo/ /nag ser dmar ljang rta sogs zhon 'gros kyis/ /dam can༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ khu ba phye mar la sogs g.yos sbyar zas/ /lo 'bras la sogs za zhing sman sna'i bcud/ /srog chags sna tshogs bsad pa'i sha rus spungs/ /khrag chang btung ba zho sogs ldag myang gis/ /dam can༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ g.yang gzhi khrag 'dzag rgyu ma glo snying gis/ /nam mkha' bar snang sprin phung ltar gtibs shing /

/ro dum thod tshal sha rus sa gzhi gang / /klad khrag tshil sogs dri dud 'jigs rung gis/ /dam can༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ go khrab mtshon chas bdud 'joms rnal 'byor skyong / /seng glang stag lpags shun pas gzi brjid bskyed/ /gos dar yid 'ong rin chen do shal mdzes/ /mkha' 'gro rang bzhin 'du ba'i spyan gzigs kyis/ /dam can༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ khyung sogs dri zhon lam nas thogs med rgyu/ /seng sogs mi 'jigs gcan gzan ngar sgra 'byin/ /'brong sogs ri dwags du ma bag phebs shing / /rta sogs lha mi'i zhon pa dud 'gro'i tshogs/ /dam can༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ nor bu gser dngul nor sna ri bor 'gran/ /nas 'bras 'bru rigs dbyig ldan rdul rnyed bzhin/ /mtho ris yo byad mkho dgus stong gsum gang / /dpal 'byor nam mkha' mdzod kyi kha phye ba'i/ /dam can༞ /rno myur༞ /kun khyab༞ /'khor bcas༞ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ mdor na dam can mkha' 'gro kun dgyes pa'i/ /thun mong phul byung mchod gtor gsang rgyud las/ /ji skad gsung rnams kun bzang rnam 'phrul bzhin/ /phyogs dus kun tu rgyun chad med pa yis/ /dam can bdag nyid mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /rno myur shwa na mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /kun khyab bse mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /'khor bcas thugs dam skong la phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ bdag cag las nyon bag med snyoms las kyis/ /so thar byang sems rig 'dzin sdom dang 'gal/ /khyad par bstan srung dam tshig las 'das kun/ /mi 'chab mi sbed nongs bshags kyis dag shog /phrin las dus la babs pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ /snyigs dus bstan pa 'jig nye 'di srungs shig /bstan 'dzin skyong zhing 'jig rten bde ba dang / /bdag gi re smon kun kyang myur 'grub shog /khyad par bstan dang bdag la 'tshe byed pa'i/
